description: This file implements HTTP stream handling for port forwarding in Kubernetes, including stream upgrade, validation, management of stream pairs, and forwarding logic.

classes.name: httpStreamHandler
classes.description: Handles multiple port forward requests over a single HTTP stream connection, managing stream pairs and forwarding ports.

classes.name: httpStreamPair
classes.description: Represents a pair of streams (error and data) for a port forwarding request.

methods.name: httpStreamReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming streams, validates headers, and dispatches them to the appropriate stream pair.

methods.name: getStreamPair
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a stream pair for a given request ID.

methods.name: monitorStreamPair
methods.description: Waits for both streams in a pair to be received or for timeout, then removes the pair.

methods.name: hasStreamPair
methods.description: Checks if a stream pair exists for a given request ID.

methods.name: removeStreamPair
methods.description: Removes a stream pair from the handler.

methods.name: requestID
methods.description: Determines the request ID from a stream, supporting older clients without explicit request IDs.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop processing incoming streams and connection closure.

methods.name: portForward
methods.description: Invokes port forwarding for a stream pair.

methods.name: newPortForwardPair
methods.description: Creates a new stream pair for a request ID.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a stream to a stream pair, returning completion status.

methods.name: printError
methods.description: Outputs an error message to the error stream.
